focus.title: Subject-Verb Agreement and Uncountable Nouns
focus.explanation: To move from B1 to B2, prioritize basic grammatical accuracy: ensure third-person singular and plural subjects agree with their verbs (e.g., 'people speak', 'it makes', 'they are'). In addition, learn standard non-count nouns such as 'knowledge', 'music', and 'information', which cannot take plural endings or words like 'many'.
